test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. Some professors are doctors.

2. No doctor is a researcher.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some professors are not researchers.

II. All professors are researchers.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
**Statements:**

1. Some professors are doctors.

2. No doctor is a researcher.

**Possible Venn Diagram:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/675c2576d29d174785ae820ff149f02c6538671180a452c9cc610afed71b8718.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some professors are not researchers → **True **(Since some professors are doctors and no doctor is a researcher)

II. All professors are researchers → False (It is not possible)

Hence, only** conclusion I** follows.
